subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — initial scheduling / potential reschedule
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo — quick sync and proposed times

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the interest. We'd love to run a 45-min live demo of Redwood Inference for your engineering and security teams to cover: runtime performance, security controls (VPC/KMS), and rollout/ops patterns for production.

Proposed time slots (PT):
- Thu Mar 12, 10:00–10:45am
- Thu Mar 12, 2:00–2:45pm
- Mon Mar 15, 11:00–11:45am

Dev (cc'd) would lead the technical portion and can address integration questions. Please let me know which time works best or propose alternatives — also please loop in procurement/security if they'd like to attend.

If helpful, I can send a calendar invite once we lock a time. Slides and a short SOW draft attached for context.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
attachments: redwood-demo-slides.pdf, proposed-sow-v1.docx

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the options. Anika (engineering) and I can do Thu Mar 12 but procurement and security will need to join — I copied them. One note: we're having an on-prem maintenance window this week (Thu morning) so the 10am slot probably won't work for our infra folks. 2pm PT looks best for us on Thu.

Also, our procurement team has a quick PO/contract checklist request — procurement@ will confirm timelines. Security asked if you can include a short architecture slide and a list of any data shared with Redwood during a demo (logs, traces, no customer PII).

—Sanjay

Marissa

Thanks — 2pm Thu works for engineering. One update: we've just been notified that we'll have an outage next week for a regional network upgrade, and it's looking like the window may extend longer than expected. If that happens, we might need to push the demo out; procurement also has biweekly approvals next Tue and can't finalize PO details until then.

Can we tentatively hold Mar 12, and if the outage gets extended we can move to the week of Mar 22? Would that work for you?

Anika

Hi all —

Thanks for the update, Anika — completely understand. Let's tentatively hold Thu Mar 12 at 2pm PT for now and agree to confirm or move the session by EOD Tue Mar 16. If your outage runs long, the week of Mar 22 (Mon/Wed preferred) works for me and Dev.

Procurement — since PO timing is a blocker for next steps, happy to loop in our finance lead to accelerate a standard SOW/PO path if that helps. Avery, can you connect with procurement and advise?

Security — we've attached the arch slide and a short data-handling note; happy to add anything else you need prior to the demo.

I'll wait to hear back from everyone and will send a tentative calendar invite (with attachments) for Thu Mar 12 2:00pm PT — please consider it tentative until we confirm.

Best,
